LapFit sell plan for APPLE 2020 Macbook Air M1 · 8 GB / 256 GB
Date: 13 Nov 2026
(A sample estimate, not a promise. The factors are sample assumptions, not learned from real sales.)

Estimated range: ₹34,000 to ₹43,500, list at about ₹43,500
Based on the new price on file: ₹86,990 as of 10 Nov 2026.

Factors used (sample):
- Age 2 years: x0.6
- Condition: fair: x0.8
- Battery 70% (below 80): x0.93

What else could get you more:
- Replace the battery: Battery health is 70%, which lowers what buyers pay. (Adds about ₹4,500, costs about ₹3,500 (sample estimate, not a quote): net ₹1,000. Worth doing on these numbers.) [source: rule]
- Find the original bill: The bill proves the purchase date and that it is yours. (Adds about ₹1,000 to the middle of the sample estimate if you have it) [source: rule]
- Find the original box: Buyers pay a little more for a complete set. (Adds about ₹500 to the middle of the sample estimate if you have it) [source: rule]
- Check whether warranty is still left: If it is, show the end date and the invoice: buyers pay more for cover. (Adds about ₹2,000 to the middle of the sample estimate if it is still under warranty) [source: rule]
- Sell sooner rather than later: The sample age factor goes from 0.6 to 0.5 when the laptop is one year older. (Waiting a year lowers the sample estimate by about ₹6,500) [source: rule]
- Clean it and reset it: A clean laptop with photos in daylight and a fresh reset looks cared for. I have no data on how much this adds, so I give no figure. [source: rule]
- What the web says about reselling this laptop: Live reviews are not switched on in this version, so I am showing only the recorded dataset. [source: web, not verified]

Checklist:
- Back up your files, sign out of every account on it and do a full reset before the buyer sees it.
- Clean the screen, keyboard and body, and take clear photos in daylight.
- Find the original bill and box if you still have them: they raise the price buyers will pay.
- Include the original charger.
- List at about ₹43,500 and expect offers down to about ₹34,000.
- Meet in a public place and let the buyer test it before they pay.

blocks.title: Before you sell
items: Back up your files, sign out of every account on it and do a full reset before the buyer sees it.
Meet in a public place and let the buyer test it before they pay.
Say honestly about any fault: it protects you from a dispute later.
